design.signal: Compare short temporal chroma changes in bilateral lower-face skin with bilateral cheek skin. Subtract a common upper-face trace and use one- and two-frame second differences. The comparison makes no physiological inference.
design.arms: The first arm measures a rise in bilateral local chroma relative to luminance and cheeks. The second measures a rise in lower-face left-right chroma disagreement, relative to cheek disagreement. Both horizons and temporal flanks must support the increase.
design.window: 8, 12, 16 or 20 pictures with six-picture flanks and the required one-shot support. Use the third-highest ordinary GRID development response per arm, with a preset floor of 0.10.
design.held: 92 previously exposed H.264 deliveries, including 17 authored redraws from two workflows and 75 ordinary controls. Timing labels are independent of this check.
design.gate: Locate at least four timing-qualified first-family edits across three sources and the timing-qualified second-family edit, with time IoU at least 0.5. Measure at least 70% of each ordinary and neural set. Allow at most two ordinary alerts and none on unaltered or hard-cut controls.
